title: Prop 15.268 pairing-pole square; ε(m_σ∘τ,S)=+1; ν=0 on all |κ|=1; residual (i) OPEN on |μ|

pole_square.theorem: For the pairing involution swapping a↔b, c↔d with Δ=a+b−c−d≠0, the pole is r=(ab−cd)/Δ and ∏(s−r) is a square in F_q^×, hence ε(τ,S)=+1.  Δ=0 ⇒ affine pairing ⇒ χ(det)=1.

epsilon.theorem: On every finite |κ|=1 four-set there is τ∈Stab_PGL(S) with χ(det τ)=−1, and g=m_σ∘τ lies in PSL, sends S to πS, and satisfies ε(g,S)=ε(τ,S)=+1.

transform.theorem: For g∈PSL, (Uy)_i=D_i y_{g(i)} is an orthogonal Aut of C, hence m₄⁺(S)=ε(g,S) m₄⁺(g(S)) and ν(S)=ε(g,S) ν(g(S)).

nu_zero.theorem: ν=0 on every |κ|=1 four-set: finite case by ε=+1 and m₄⁻(S)=m₄⁺(πS); ∞-sets by 3-transitive PSL transport.

hinge.open: ν=0 on all |κ|=1 (15.266 obstruction closed).  Still need |μ|≤1/(2p) / envelope / reflection / Es4 / ker=sc.

F3: ν=0 on every |κ|=1 four-set (finite by ε=+1 for g=m_σ∘τ; ∞-sets by PSL transport).  15.266 obstruction closed.  |μ|≤1/(2p) still OPEN.  No predicate flip.
